name: compartment_vision_closeout
_label: Camera-based discovery (two cameras, vision world model), first held-out evaluation. Seeds 5200-5209 per kind: verified by grep to appear in no config, result or test (the seen compartment set is 5000-5029; development used 0-11). The development results (0/12 on the first vision dev run, 2/4 on the continuation) were weak, so a failure here is an accepted, reportable result. Nothing is tuned after seeing these results; thresholds and noise models are the oracle-calibrated ones used in the development runs. Code is the committed tree at the recorded git SHA.
_seed_check: grep of experiments/configs, results/*, tests, experiments/*.py, README for seeds 5100-5999: only 5000-5029 (results/compartment, results/compartment_regression_vision_fixes) occur.

gates._note: Same names and form as experiments/configs/compartment.json held-out gates. Requested minimum for openable success was 0.70; compartment.json's gate of the same name is stricter (0.8) so 0.8 is used. fixed 'declined' is the runner's correct_rejection (no open_articulated call and no claim).
